title: Bee as shappyn
description: Ten short, simple stories about food, eating out and shopping on the Isle of Man.

lessons.title: Yn thie bee noa
lessons.summary: Paul gets up early on an important day: his new restaurant near the harbour in Peel opens.
lessons.text:
She laa scanshoil eh jiu. Ta thie bee noa ec Paul Kewley, as jiu ta'n thie bee goaill toshiaght.

Ta'n thie bee faggys da'n phurt ayns Pheeil. Ta'n thie beg, as t'eh bane.

Ta Paul irree leah. T'eh irree roish ny sleih elley 'sy valley, as t'eh goll dys y phurt. Ayns y phurt, ta dooinney shenn lesh eeast. Ta laue vooar ec y dooinney, as t'eh cur yn eeast da Paul lesh e laue vooar.

“She laa scanshoil eh jiu,” dooyrt Paul. “Ta'n thie bee noa goaill toshiaght.”

“Ta mee çheet dys y thie bee bane,” dooyrt y dooinney.

Ec y jerrey jeh'n laa, haink ymmodee sleih veih'n phurt dys y thie bee. Hug Paul bee da dagh dooinney as da dagh ben. Va'n bee mie, as va'n laa mie.

Hug y dooinney shenn e laue da Paul. “She thie bee mie eh,” dooyrt eh.

Feyshtyn:
Vel y thie bee faggys da'n phurt?
Ta. Ta'n thie bee faggys da'n phurt ayns Pheeil.
Vel y thie bane?
Ta. Ta'n thie beg, as t'eh bane.
Vel Paul irree leah?
Ta. T'eh irree leah, as t'eh goll dys y phurt.
Hooar Paul eeast veih dooinney 'sy phurt?
Hooar. Hug y dooinney shenn yn eeast da Paul.

lessons.title: Yn laa ruggyree
lessons.summary: Robert looks for a birthday present for Isla, who is four, and finds a cheap red book.
lessons.text:
Ta Isla Quirk kiare bleeaney d'eash jiu. She yn laa ruggyree eck. Ta Robert Quirk, ayr Isla, goll dys y valley son red mie son y laa ruggyree.

Ta thie mooar 'sy valley, as ta ymmodee sorçh dy reddyn ayn: lioaryn, blaaghyn, as sorçh dy vee. Ta Robert jeeaghyn er dagh sorçh.

Ta lioar jiarg ayn, cho jiarg as blaa. She lioar son paitçhyn kiare bleeaney d'eash.

“By vie lhiam unnane jeh ny lioaryn jiarg,” ta Robert gra rish y ven 'sy thie mooar. “Vel ad seyr?”

“Ta,” ta'n ven gra. “Ta ny lioaryn jiarg seyr jiu.”

Ta Robert goaill unnane. “By vie lhiam y lioar jiarg shoh,” t'eh gra. Ta'n lioar seyr, as t'ee mie.

Ec y thie, ta Isla jeeaghyn er y lioar jiarg.

“Cha nel lioar erbee aym cho mie as shoh!” t'ee gra. Cha row laa ruggyree erbee cho mie as y laa shoh.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Isla kiare bleeaney d'eash?
Ta. Ta Isla kiare bleeaney d'eash jiu.
Vel ymmodee sorçh dy reddyn 'sy thie mooar?
Ta. Ta lioaryn, blaaghyn as sorçh dy vee ayn.
Vel ny lioaryn jiarg seyr?
Ta. Ta ny lioaryn jiarg seyr jiu.
Vel Isla jeeaghyn er y lioar jiarg?
Ta. T'ee jeeaghyn er y lioar ec y thie.

lessons.title: Ny lossreeyn ec Grace
lessons.summary: From April to August Grace grows food plants, moving the small ones out of the tree's shade.
lessons.text:
Ta thalloo beg ec Grace Kinrade liorish e thie. Ayns Averil, ta Grace soie lossreeyn 'sy thalloo: lossreeyn son bee. Ta billey shenn ayns mean y thalloo myrgeddin.

Ayns Averil, cha nel ram soilshey ayn, as ta ny lossreeyn beg. Ta Grace cur ushtey daue, as ta'n ushtey goll sheese 'sy thalloo.

Ayns Boaldyn, ta ram soilshey ayn. Ta ny lossreeyn aase seose dys yn aer. Agh ta'n billey ard, as cha nel ram soilshey fo'n villey. Ta ny lossreeyn fo'n villey foast beg.

Ta Grace goaill ny lossreeyn beggey veih fo'n villey, as t'ee cur ad 'sy thalloo ayns y soilshey.

Ayns Luanistyn, ta ny lossreeyn mooar, as ta bee er y villey myrgeddin. Ta Grace goaill y bee sheese veih'n villey.

“Ta'n soilshey as yn ushtey mie son lossreeyn,” t'ee gra. “As yn aer myrgeddin.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Grace soie lossreeyn ayns Averil?
Ta. T'ee soie lossreeyn son bee 'sy thalloo.
Vel ram soilshey ayn ayns Boaldyn?
Ta. Ayns Boaldyn, ta ram soilshey ayn.
Vel ny lossreeyn fo'n villey mooar?
Cha nel. Ta ny lossreeyn fo'n villey foast beg.
Vel bee er y villey ayns Luanistyn?
Ta. Ayns Luanistyn, ta bee er y villey.

lessons.title: Frangish 'sy thie bee
lessons.summary: Rosie learns French at school; Pierre, who runs a French restaurant, teaches her the food words.
lessons.text:
Ta Rosie Faragher ayns y scoill ayns Doolish. 'Sy scoill, ta Rosie ynsaghey Frangish. She glare mie ee, agh cha nel fys ec Rosie er ram focklyn.

Faggys da'n scoill, ta thie bee Frangish ec Pierre. She Frangish e hengey ghooghyssagh. Ta Yernish echey myrgeddin, son va Pierre cummal ayns Nerin.

Dagh laa, ta Pierre caghlaa y bee 'sy thie bee. Ta'n bee caghlaa, as ta ny focklyn caghlaa myrgeddin.

Hie Rosie dys y thie bee lurg y scoill.

“Vel oo loayrt Frangish?” dooyrt Pierre.

“Ta mee ynsaghey Frangish 'sy scoill,” dooyrt Rosie. “Agh cha nel fys aym er ny focklyn son bee.”

Ta Pierre loayrt Frangish rish Rosie. T'eh gra fockle son dagh red, as ta Rosie gra y fockle. She aght mie eh dy ynsaghey glare.

“Ta'n aght shoh mie,” dooyrt Rosie. “Ta fys aym er ram focklyn noa.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Rosie ynsaghey Frangish 'sy scoill?
Ta. T'ee ynsaghey Frangish 'sy scoill ayns Doolish.
Nee Frangish çhengey ghooghyssagh Pierre?
She. She Frangish e hengey ghooghyssagh.
Vel Yernish ec Pierre?
Ta. Ta Yernish echey, son v'eh cummal ayns Nerin.
Vel Pierre caghlaa y bee dagh laa?
Ta. T'eh caghlaa y bee 'sy thie bee dagh laa.

lessons.title: Yn aundyr
lessons.summary: Martin, a cook from Ramsey, wins the prize for the best food in a television contest.
lessons.text:
Ta Martin Gelling jannoo bee ayns thie bee ayns Rhumsaa. Ta Martin goll dys cloie mooar er y çhellveeish, son aundyr. Ta'n aundyr son y bee share.

Hie Martin dys Doolish, far va'n chloie. Va'n ynnyd mooar as sollys, as va kiaull ayn. Va millioon sleih jeeaghyn er y chloie er y çhellveeish.

Va tree keimyn 'sy chloie. Ayns dagh keim, ren Martin bee noa. Va tree fir oikoil ayn. Hug Martin ayrn jeh'n bee da dagh fer oikoil.

Ayns y chied cheim, va'n bee mie. Ayns y nah cheim, va'n bee share. Ec y jerrey, ren Martin bee jiarg lesh lussyn, as ghow dagh fer oikoil ayrn jeh.

Chossyn Martin yn aundyr! Va kiaull ayn, as va soilshey sollys er Martin.

“She laa mooar eh,” dooyrt eh. “Chossyn mee yn aundyr son y thie bee ayns Rhumsaa.”

Feyshtyn:
Hie Martin dys cloie er y çhellveeish?
Hie. Hie eh dys Doolish, far va'n chloie.
Row millioon sleih jeeaghyn?
Va. Va millioon sleih jeeaghyn er y çhellveeish.
Hug Martin ayrn jeh'n bee da ny fir oikoil?
Hug. Hug eh ayrn da dagh fer oikoil.
Chossyn Martin yn aundyr?
Chossyn. Chossyn eh yn aundyr son y bee share.

lessons.title: Yn towl 'sy cheeill
lessons.summary: The church society, run by Nora, sells food after the services and builds a new roof.
lessons.text:
Ta keeill shenn 'sy valley, as ta towl mooar ayn. Ta ushtey çheet stiagh 'sy cheeill trooid y towl.

Ta sheshaght ayns y cheeill. Ta Nora Kissack reirey yn çheshaght, as ta Owen Callister oltey jeh'n çheshaght.

“Ta argid scanshoil son y towl,” dooyrt Nora rish ny olteynyn.

Ren ny olteynyn bee. Lurg y shirveish, ghow ny sleih bee, as hug ad argid da'n çheshaght. Ga nagh row ram argid ec ny sleih, hug dagh unnane red beg.

Va shirveish elley ayn yn nah laa. Lurg y shirveish shen, va lieh jeh'n argid ec y çheshaght. Lurg mee, va'n daa lieh ec y çheshaght.

Ren Nora reirey yn obbyr. Haink fir veih'n valley, as ren ad troggal ayrn noa er y cheeill. Ren Owen troggal myrgeddin, ga dy vel eh shenn.

Myr eiyrtys, cha nel towl erbee ayns y cheeill. Myr eiyrtys elley, ta olteynyn noa ayns y çheshaght.

Feyshtyn:
Row towl ayns y cheeill?
Va. Va towl mooar ayns y cheeill shenn.
Vel Nora reirey yn çheshaght?
Ta. Ta Nora reirey yn çheshaght, as ta Owen ny oltey.
Hug ny sleih argid son y bee lurg y shirveish?
Hug. Hug dagh unnane red beg.
Vel towl erbee ayns y cheeill?
Cha nel. Myr eiyrtys jeh'n obbyr, cha nel towl erbee ayn.

lessons.title: Yn scannane
lessons.summary: A film is made in Peel; the actor and the writer eat at Kate's café, which is like the café in their story.
lessons.text:
Ta thie bee beg ec Kate Craine ayns ayrn veanagh Pheeil. Ta sleih croo scannane noa 'sy valley.

Ta Adam Cannell ny aghteyr 'sy scannane. Ta Ruth Costain ny screeudeyr: screeu ee skeeal y scannane. Dagh laa, ta'n aghteyr as y screeudeyr goll dys thie bee Kate. T'adsyn gee ayn dagh laa, as s'mie lhieu y bee.

“Ta'n thie bee ayns y scannane gollrish y thie bee ayd,” dooyrt Ruth rish Kate. “She'n thie bee yn boayl meanagh 'sy scannane.”

“Vel enmys ec y scannane?” dooyrt Kate.

“Ta,” dooyrt Ruth. “She ‘Yn Thie Bee Beg’ yn enmys.”

Yn laa ny yei, ren ny sleih croo ayrn jeh'n scannane ayns thie bee Kate hene. Va Adam ayns y thie bee, as va Kate jeeaghyn er. T'adsyn cloie, as t'ee jeeaghyn.

Ny yei, hug Adam jalloo jeh hene da Kate. She jalloo mie eh, as ta'n jalloo ayns y thie bee foast.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Adam ny aghteyr 'sy scannane?
Ta. Ta Adam Cannell ny aghteyr, as ta Ruth ny screeudeyr.
Vel y thie bee 'sy scannane gollrish y thie bee ec Kate?
Ta. T'eh gollrish y thie bee ayns ayrn veanagh Pheeil.
Vel enmys ec y scannane?
Ta. She ‘Yn Thie Bee Beg’ yn enmys.
Hug Adam jalloo da Kate?
Hug. Hug eh jalloo jeh hene da Kate ny yei.

lessons.title: Oaylleeaght 'sy scoill
lessons.summary: Ellen visits Sam's school with a small plant and explains plant cells and how plants make food.
lessons.text:
Ta Sam Kneen ayns y scoill. Jiu, ta Sam ynsaghey oaylleeaght.

Ta Ellen Watterson jannoo studeyrys er lossreeyn. T'ee çheet dys y scoill lesh losserey beg.

“Ta dagh losserey jeant jeh killagyn,” dooyrt Ellen. “Ta millioon killag ayns un losserey mooar. Ta killagyn ayns dooinney myrgeddin, as ta killagyn dooinney cosoylagh rish killagyn losserey.”

Ta Sam jeeaghyn er ny killagyn. Ta ny killagyn feer veggey.

“Ta'n losserey goaill soilshey as ushtey,” dooyrt Ellen, “as t'eh croo stoo son bee. She stoo scanshoil eh. Gyn y stoo shoh, cha nel bee ayn er y chruinney.”

“Vel ymmodee kynneeyn dy lossreeyn ayn?” dooyrt Sam.

“Ta,” dooyrt Ellen. “Ta ymmodee kynneeyn er feie ny cruinney. Ta dagh kynney cosoylagh rish kynney elley, agh cha nel ad y cheddin.”

Ta'n losserey beg aase dy jeeragh seose dys y soilshey. Lurg y scoill, ta Sam goll dy jeeragh dys y thie.

“She studeyrys mie eh,” dooyrt Sam. “Ta oaylleeaght mie.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Sam ynsaghey oaylleeaght?
Ta. Ta Sam ynsaghey oaylleeaght 'sy scoill jiu.
Vel losserey jeant jeh killagyn?
Ta. Ta millioon killag ayns un losserey mooar.
Vel killagyn dooinney cosoylagh rish killagyn losserey?
Ta. T'ad cosoylagh.
Vel ymmodee kynneeyn dy lossreeyn er y chruinney?
Ta. Ta ymmodee kynneeyn er feie ny cruinney.

lessons.title: Yn çheshaght bee ynnydagh
lessons.summary: Freya, president of a local food society founded in 1952, sees it join with a society in Ramsey.
lessons.text:
Ta Freya Christian ny eaghtyrane jeh sheshaght bee ynnydagh ayns Doolish. Va'n çheshaght bunnit 'sy vlein 1952.

Ta shennaghys mooar ec y çheshaght. Ayns y shennaghys, va ny sleih geddyn bee ynnydagh veih ny thallooyn 'syn ellan. Ayns ny bleeantyn jeianagh, ta ram bee çheet veih Sostyn as veih ny h-Ellanyn Goaldagh elley.

“Ta bee Goaldagh mie,” dooyrt Freya, “agh ta bee ynnydagh share.”

Ta un reill ec y çheshaght: ta dagh oltey goaill bee ynnydagh. Ta'n reill shoh scanshoil.

Jiu, ta unnaneys noa ayn eddyr y çheshaght ayns Doolish as y çheshaght ayns Rhumsaa. Ta Freya ny eaghtyrane jeh'n unnaneys noa. Ta'n unnaneys mie son y bee ynnydagh.

Haink oltey jeh partee ashoonagh dys y çheshaght jiu, myrane lesh fer veih'n reiltys. Ta'n partee shoh son bee ynnydagh myrgeddin.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Freya ny eaghtyrane jeh'n çheshaght?
Ta. T'ee ny eaghtyrane jeh'n çheshaght bee ynnydagh.
Row'n çheshaght bunnit 'sy vlein 1952?
Va. Va'n çheshaght bunnit 'sy vlein 1952.
Vel ram bee çheet veih Sostyn ayns ny bleeantyn jeianagh?
Ta. Ta ram bee çheet veih Sostyn.
Vel unnaneys noa ayn eddyr y daa heshaght?
Ta. Ta unnaneys noa ayn, as ta Freya ny eaghtyrane.
Haink oltey jeh partee dys y çheshaght?
Haink. Haink eh myrane lesh fer veih'n reiltys.

lessons.title: Bee fo ny rollageyn
lessons.summary: After a big match Gareth has no energy; Lily brings food, and they eat and lie under the stars.
lessons.text:
Ta Gareth Skillicorn ny chloieder. T'eh cloie bluckan son possan ayns Doolish. Jiu, va cloie mooar ayn. Lurg y chloie, cha row bree erbee ec Gareth.

“Cha nel bree aym,” dooyrt eh rish Lily Clucas.

“She bee yn oyr,” dooyrt Lily. “Cha row bee ayd jiu. She shen yn fa.”

Ghow Lily bee lhee, as hie ad magh dys thalloo ard liorish y vooir. Ren ad lhie er y thalloo, as ren ad gee y bee. Lurg y bee, va bree noa ec Gareth.

Va'n aer doo, as va ny rollageyn sollys. Ren Gareth as Lily lhie fo ny rollageyn. Va Lily soilshaghey ny rollageyn da Gareth.

“Shoh rollage vooar,” dooyrt ee. “As shoh rollage elley.”

Ren ad ceau traa er y thalloo ard. Ren ad ceau traa mie fo ny rollageyn.

“She shoh yn fa ta mee cloie,” dooyrt Gareth. “Son laghyn mie. As she oyr elley y bee!”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Gareth ny chloieder?
Ta. T'eh cloie bluckan son possan ayns Doolish.
Row bree ec Gareth lurg y chloie?
Cha row. Cha row bree erbee echey.
Ren ad lhie fo ny rollageyn?
Ren. Ren ad lhie er y thalloo ard fo ny rollageyn.
Ren Lily soilshaghey ny rollageyn da Gareth?
Ren. Va Lily soilshaghey ny rollageyn da Gareth.
